status: Exploratory definition after reading PR509 angular bridge fb01c44a, before computing this decomposition
question: Which part of the original global source response comes from occupancy mixing and which from rank-selective reweighting at fixed occupancy?
source_units: bulk s=CB+CW; all response derivatives couple to exp(t*s), no extra factor N

projection.global_identity: For every p and every readout f(K,q), its first source response under s equals occupancy plus rank_selective; spatial_residual response is identically zero
projection.finite_strength_boundary: This is a first-order projection. Exponentiating the projected conditional mean generally does not reproduce the finite-strength source measure
projection.field_boundary: Arbitrary K- and geometry-dependent projection is a sufficient readout representation, not a scalar-field identity, constant q/E closure, or microscopic causal explanation

computation.root: reuse original saved pooled p0 for the same retained sample; no root finder
computation.responses: full moving-root/slopenormalized v=partial_t U, root motion and root-comoving rank1 population; all are linear in the source tangent at the common baseline
computation.unperturbed_U: original N^(13/8)*P4[E_p]/(2D), retained without refitting exponent
computation.uncertainty: recompute conditional means and entire decomposition in each original aligned delete-one group; same source three groups, 100 omissions; keep full covariance and chain contrasts
computation.sampling: cyclic100k and endpoint1M same old source marks; endpoint batch is old1000 union increment9000; no new counters, no replay, no server
computation.plug_in_boundary: Empirical projection and its jackknife are data-adaptive descriptive source components; they are not independently sampled fixed interventions or extra evidence

comparison_policy: Report signed components with joint uncertainty. Do not convert a weak total into unstable percentage attribution; no free exponent, high-dimensional model search or new significance selection
